items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I played many times with Tats, yeah.

ctx.x: And I know of course Tats, Adolph Alexander, any relation to them? No, I played with Tats, but he's kind of paralyzed. Yeah, he had a sort of stroke.
I played many times with Tats, yeah. He's paralyzed now.
